hook_text: The first test of Grade 9 does not count. Here is why you should still try hard on it.
clip_script: Grade 8 left five tools in your box. IDMEC: investigate, design, make, evaluate, communicate. Line types: dark, feint, dashed. Forces: tension, compression, bending, torsion, shear. Gears: driven teeth over driver teeth, speed for force. Circuits: cells push, current flows, resistance slows. Grade 9 uses every one of them, on a staircase and ramp, on hydraulics, on an electronic device. The baseline test in week one is a mirror, not a mark. Try honestly, leave the blanks honest, and the gaps get fixed before they matter. Prepare by covering the page and saying the idea, not by rereading.
visual_style: Whiteboard toolbox opening to five labelled tools, each sketched quickly; a mirror icon for the baseline; a covered textbook page with a question mark.
pacing: Five tools in twenty seconds, the mirror idea, the recall tip.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson and test yourself on one idea from each Grade 8 term.
